description: The file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DirectLex, a custom PHP implementation of an HTML parser and lexer used within the HTMLPurifier project. It provides functionality for tokenizing HTML content, handling tags, comments, and attributes, with configuration options for line numbering and error collection.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DirectLex
classes.description: A custom PHP parser and lexer for processing HTML content, capable of tokenizing HTML into various token objects, handling comments, tags, attributes, and line number tracking based on configuration.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Tokenizes an input HTML string into an array of token objects, normalizing HTML, handling scripts, and managing line/column positions if configured.

methods.name: parseAttributeString
methods.description: Converts a string of HTML tag attributes into an associative array of attribute key-value pairs, handling quoted and bool attributes.

methods.name: scriptCallback
methods.description: Callback used to process script content within HTML, converting it to a normalized format with HTML special characters.
